mapper.select: select citation.citation_id, citation.message_id, citation.citation_index, citation.knowledge_base_id, citation.brand_id, citation.model_id, citation.document_id, citation.document_version_id, citation.document_title, citation.original_file_name, citation.page_number, citation.chunk_index, citation.heading, citation.quote_text, citation.score, citation.create_time from oc_ai_message_citation citation inner join oc_ai_message msg on msg.message_id = citation.message_id inner join oc_ai_conversation conv on conv.conversation_id = msg.conversation_id where conv.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and conv.user_id = #{userId} and conv.status = '0' and conv.del_flag = '0' order by citation.message_id, citation.citation_index
mapper.insert: insert into oc_ai_message_citation ( message_id, citation_index, knowledge_base_id, brand_id, model_id, document_id, document_version_id, document_title, original_file_name, page_number, chunk_index, heading, quote_text, score, create_time ) values ( #{messageId}, #{citationIndex}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{brandId}, #{modelId}, #{documentId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{documentTitle}, #{originalFileName}, #{pageNumber}, #{chunkIndex}, #{heading}, #{quote}, #{score}, sysdate() )
